name: Topstep

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No percentage-based consistency rule; instead requires 5 winning days of $200+ net profit each before the Combine can be completed

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 90/10 (100% of first $10,000 for accounts opened before Jan 12, 2026)
payoutTerms.payoutCap: Capped early in funded status; caps largely removed after 30 winning days

uniqueSellingPoints: Deep Chicago futures pedigree, one of the oldest and most recognized brands in the space (founded 2012)
Low headline entry price ($49/mo Standard Path for 50K) with a no-activation-fee alternative path
Proprietary TopstepX platform pulls data directly from exchanges with no artificial delay
weaknesses: Lowest Trustpilot score (3.6) among the major mature futures prop firms, with recurring complaints about payout denials tied to hedging/copy-trading rule enforcement
July 2026 shift to TopstepX-only for new Combines and resets removed third-party platform choice for new customers
Real-time Maximum Loss Level monitoring can trigger breaches on intraday wicks even though the drawdown floor itself only trails at end-of-day

name: Apex Trader Funding

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No consistency rule during evaluation; on funded Performance Accounts, no single day may exceed 30-50% of total profit at time of payout request (threshold has varied by rule update in 2026)

payoutTerms.payoutCap: Per-cycle withdrawal caps by account size (e.g., $1,000 on 25K, $1,500 on 50K, $2,500 on 100K, $3,500 on 150K)

uniqueSellingPoints: Largest futures prop firm by trader volume, with members in 150+ countries and up to 20 simultaneous funded accounts
Permissive one-step evaluation with no consistency rule during the eval and only a 1-day minimum trading requirement
Moved to one-time evaluation fees under the 2026 Apex 4.0 update, plus frequent deep promotional discounts (70-90% off)
weaknesses: Recurring complaints about held/delayed payouts, accounts placed 'under review' or closed shortly after becoming consistently profitable
Advertised '100% profit split' is offset by low per-cycle withdrawal caps that limit how much can actually be pulled out at once
Trustpilot score has trended down slightly in 2026 (from ~4.4 to ~4.2) as one-star review volume climbed alongside overall review growth

name: MyFundedFutures

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: 50% consistency rule on Core evaluation and Builder sim-funded accounts; no consistency rule on Rapid plan

payoutTerms.profitSplit: Up to 90% (cut from 90% to 80% on some plans in a Feb 2026 change that triggered community backlash)
payoutTerms.payoutCap: Capped for the first 60 days on some plans (e.g., $1,000/$2,000 on Builder 25K/50K); caps removed after 60 days

uniqueSellingPoints: Highest Trustpilot score of the futures group (4.9/5 across 21,000+ reviews) with $126M+ paid out across 56,900+ payouts as of mid-2026
Rapid plan offers daily payout requests, among the fastest cash-out cadence in the futures prop space
Large, active Discord community (72K+ members) and broad platform support including TradingView and Quantower
weaknesses: Complaints about sudden account terminations for alleged 'coordinated/mirrored trading' with vague evidence and limited appeal process
Customer support response times and lack of a direct line to the finance team are frequently cited as weak points
A February 2026 profit-split reduction (90% to 80% on some plans) drew significant community backlash before partial course-correction

name: Bulenox

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: At time of withdrawal, no single trading day's profit may exceed 40% of total net profit on the account

payoutTerms.profitSplit: Up to 90% (100% of first $10,000 in payouts)
payoutTerms.payoutCap: Balance-based caps by account size ($25K=$2,500, $50K=$5,000, $100K=$10,000, $150K=$15,000, $250K=$25,000); amounts above cap are paid out automatically

uniqueSellingPoints: One of the highest first-$10,000-is-100%-yours offers in the category, plus fast, reliable weekly/daily payouts frequently praised in reviews
No minimum trading days requirement to reach the Master (funded) account stage
Broadest platform selection of the group (10+ supported platforms) built around direct CME Group exchange connectivity
weaknesses: Much smaller review base (1,762 Trustpilot reviews) than the larger competitors, so its 4.7 score reflects a thinner sample
Reports of account terminations attributed to abnormal/erroneous fill prices on thin-liquidity contract months, with unclear rule notification before the breach
Occasional complaints of technical glitches and slower customer support response times

name: Earn2Trade

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: 30% minimum consistency rate required to reach funding

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 80/20 (tiered down to 50/50 below the safety-net buffer on some plans after a July 2026 update)
payoutTerms.payoutCap: Gauntlet Mini LiveSim capped at $4,000 max withdrawal before moving to a full Live account

uniqueSellingPoints: Most veteran firm in the group, operating since 2016 with a decade-long track record and an education-first brand
Trader Career Path scales up to $400K with a static (non-trailing) drawdown option, unusual in the category
No minimum trading days requirement to reach funding, only the profit target and 30% consistency threshold
weaknesses: 80% profit split is below several competitors offering 90-100%, and a July 2026 change introduced a 50/50 split below the safety-net buffer
Above-average monthly entry fees relative to some newer challengers, plus required weekend position closures and futures-only instrument access
The EOD-to-intraday-trailing drawdown switch between evaluation and Live accounts is the most-cited source of trader frustration

name: TakeProfitTrader

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No consistency rule required on Test or PRO evaluations

payoutTerms.payoutCap: None on PRO+ (uncapped daily payouts); no stated cap on PRO

uniqueSellingPoints: No consistency rule on evaluations, unusual among competitors
PRO+ tier offers daily payouts with no withdrawal cap
Up to 5 funded accounts permitted, supporting scaling
weaknesses: Frequent complaints that advertised 'instant'/same-day payouts actually take 1-3 days
Intraday trailing drawdown on PRO accounts criticized as 'easy to pass, hard to keep'
Customer support responsiveness criticized, with some users reporting no human contact for weeks

name: Tradeify

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: 40% consistency rule on Select evaluation accounts (no single day may exceed 40% of total profit)

uniqueSellingPoints: Restructured in 2026 to one-time-payment evaluations with no recurring subscription or activation fee
Fast 24-48 hour payout processing once approved
Multiple evaluation tracks (Growth, Select, Lightning) targeting different trading styles/budgets
weaknesses: Recurring complaints about KYC verification declines with no clear resubmission path
Multiple reports of payout approvals being reversed/denied hours later with accounts locked
Platform/execution issues cited as a top complaint category (Tradovate freezes, TradeSea glitches, bracket-order failures)

name: Alpha Futures Funding

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: 40-50% consistency rule depending on plan (Standard Eval 50%, Advanced Eval 40%, Qualified 40%, Zero plan has none)

uniqueSellingPoints: Among the highest Trustpilot scores in the category, with strong payout-reliability reputation
Multiple plan tiers (Zero/Standard/Advanced) letting traders choose fee vs. rule trade-offs
Fast payout processing, advertised within 48 business hours
weaknesses: 2026 platform migration from Project X to Tradovate triggered data-sync and chart-freezing complaints
Disputed stop-loss executions and Daily Loss Guard enforcement are a recurring complaint theme
Some traders report rule changes (e.g., inactivity policy) applied without direct notification

name: Blue Guardian Futures
headquarters: Saint Lucia (operational HQ in Dubai, UAE)

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: Varies by account type; consistency restrictions removed once accounts reach LIVE status

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 90/10, with 100% profit retention on the first $15,000 for new funded accounts

uniqueSellingPoints: 100% profit retention on the first $15,000 for newly funded accounts
Low-cost one-time-fee 'Guardian' evaluation plan advertised with no daily loss limit
Documented payout history exceeding $20 million across 9,200+ withdrawals
weaknesses: Multiple reports of payout rejections citing a 'second account' rule, with abrupt account/dashboard lockouts
2025 change from soft to hard daily-loss-limit breach was communicated only via an FAQ update, causing unexpected terminations
Lowest Trustpilot score of the futures group (3.8/5) with a relatively high one-star review share

name: Elite Trader Funding

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: Active Trade Days requirement: 8 days before first payout, 10 days thereafter on standard plans

payoutTerms.profitSplit: Up to 100% up to $25,000 cumulative on sim-funded stage, then 80/20 on LIVE ELITE
payoutTerms.payoutCap: $25,000 cumulative cap on sim-funded stage before transitioning to LIVE ELITE

uniqueSellingPoints: Wide platform breadth via Rithmic connectivity (9+ platforms including Quantower, Sierra Chart, Bookmap)
Multiple evaluation models (1-Step, EOD, Fast Track, Direct-to-Funded, Diamond Hands overnight)
Support tickets reported as answered quickly relative to peers
weaknesses: Low $25,000 total sim-funded payout cap limits earning runway versus competitors
Some users report being charged monthly/reset fees for months without the account actually being reset
Payout denials tied to compliance checks and hidden-rule disputes reported by some traders

name: Legends Trading

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: Elite plan: no single day may exceed 40% of total profit; Apprentice plan: 30%

payoutTerms.payoutCap: $800-$3,500 per cycle on Elite/Master funded accounts (fixed, non-scaling)

uniqueSellingPoints: Aggressive promotional pricing (up to 80-90% off during sales) makes the nominal evaluation cost among the lowest in the industry
Elite evaluation track has no daily loss limit, only an EOD trailing drawdown that stops trailing near breakeven
90/10 profit split with some traders reporting payouts processed in 4-5 days
weaknesses: Newer, still-forming reputation with a pattern of Trustpilot and scam-report complaints about profitable accounts being closed or payouts denied without clear cause right before eligibility
Confusing multi-tier product structure (Elite / Apprentice / Straight-to-Master) with different activation fees, DLLs, and consistency rules per tier
Strict, sometimes disputed enforcement of hedging/contract-count rules cited in negative reviews as leading to account termination

name: OneUp Trader

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: 3 other best trading days' net profits must sum to at least 80% of the largest day's net profit

payoutTerms.payoutCap: None specified; crypto withdrawals capped at $3,000 per request, 1 per week

uniqueSellingPoints: Highest Trustpilot rating among compared futures firms (4.7/5 across 2,700+ reviews), with a long operating history since 2017
Free unlimited account resets and no daily loss limit included with every plan
Traders only pay 50% of the evaluation fee upfront, with the remainder due only upon passing
weaknesses: Unregulated by any financial authority, a point flagged repeatedly by third-party reviewers
Futures-only, intraday-only model - no swing/overnight holds, no crypto or equities products
Reported ~90% decline in brand search interest since its 2021 peak, suggesting shrinking mindshare versus newer entrants

name: Leeloo Trading
headquarters: United States (public records disagree on exact HQ - Montana and Georgia have both been cited)

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: 30% Rule: no single trading day's profit may exceed 30% of total net profit for the payout period

uniqueSellingPoints: Distinctive two-stage 'Practice Account to Performance Account' model with manually reviewed payout requests rather than fully automated evaluation
Traders keep 100% of the first $8,000-$12,500 in profits before the 90/10 split applies
Broad Rithmic-based platform support (Bookmap, MotiveWave, ATAS, Jigsaw Daytradr) beyond the standard NinjaTrader/Tradovate options
weaknesses: Trustpilot score has fallen to roughly 3.1/5 in 2026 with recurring complaints of denied payouts and account terminations shortly after profitable withdrawal requests
At least one third-party analysis flagged the site's older 5-star review volume as showing signs of inauthentic/fake review patterns
Monthly-only, fixed-date payout cycle (15th of the month) is less flexible than firms offering weekly or on-demand withdrawals

name: FundedNext Futures

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: Flex/Legacy: no single day may exceed 40% of total profit; Rapid Daily: no consistency rule at any stage

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 80/20 base rising to 95/5 with add-on (Flex/Legacy); up to 90/10 (Rapid)

uniqueSellingPoints: Massive scale and track record - $261M+ paid out to 93,000+ traders as of April 2026; only major brand running both CFD and Futures programs together
Fast payouts guaranteed within 24 hours (about 5 hours average processing) with no monthly platform or data-feed surcharges
Multiple challenge formats (Rapid Pro, Rapid Daily, Legacy, Flex) let traders pick between no-daily-target speed runs and more traditional benchmark-day evaluations
weaknesses: No Rithmic support for futures - traders are limited to Tradovate-based execution
Recurring complaints about account terminations on vague 'prohibited strategy' grounds with confiscated profits and limited explanation from support
Reported execution/slippage issues during high-volatility news events (e.g., NFP) with inconsistent support follow-through on technical disputes

name: FTMO

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No formal consistency rule enforced during the standard 2-Step Challenge/Verification phases; some third-party sources reference an informal ~30% max-single-day-profit guideline tied to scaling/payout eligibility, unconfirmed on official rule pages

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 80/20 (scales to 90/10 via Scaling Plan; 1-Step program starts at 90/10)
payoutTerms.payoutCap: None disclosed on funded-account payouts; Scaling Plan caps total funded capital at $2,000,000 per trader

uniqueSellingPoints: Challenge fee is 100% refunded with the trader's first profit split, effectively making evaluation free for those who pass
Largest and highest-rated review base in the prop-trading industry (4.8/5 across 50,000+ Trustpilot reviews)
Choice of MT4, MT5, cTrader or DXtrade, with a Scaling Plan that can grow funded capital up to $2M
weaknesses: Recurring trader complaints of payouts being denied or accounts breached over minor/technical rule breaches
Customer support response times criticized in reviews as slow, with some traders reporting multi-day to multi-month waits on disputed cases
No futures or crypto evaluation products; forex/CFD only, and reset (retry) costs the full fee again

name: E8 Markets

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: ~40% best-day rule on standard (E8 One/Classic) products; the one-step E8 Zero product removes both the consistency rule and trailing drawdown

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 80/20 by default, selectable up to 90/10 or 100/0 at purchase for a higher evaluation fee (E8 One)
payoutTerms.payoutCap: None disclosed on individual payouts; E8 One accounts can scale up to $1,000,000

uniqueSellingPoints: Highly customizable E8 One evaluation: traders choose profit target, drawdown %, drawdown type, and profit split at signup
No minimum trading days on any product, with a lenient 60-day inactivity window
One-time-fee model only with activation fees eliminated, scaling to $1M+ funded capital
weaknesses: As of research date, Trustpilot displays a guideline-breach warning and withholds E8's overall score after removing a batch of fake reviews
Multiple trader complaints of large payouts being delayed or denied after post-hoc rule-violation accusations surfacing only once a withdrawal was requested
Rules and pricing are fragmented across several distinct product lines (E8 One, Zero, Pro, Signature, Classic, Futures), making comparison hard

name: The 5%ers

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No profit-consistency requirement on the High Stakes program; account must place at least 1 trade every 30 days to avoid inactivity closure

uniqueSellingPoints: One of the longest-running prop firms (founded 2016) with a large, consistently high Trustpilot score (4.7/5 across 36K+ reviews)
Aggressive profit-split scaling, reaching up to 100% trader retention, with scaling to $4M in capital
No minimum trading days on flagship challenges, giving traders unlimited time to pass
weaknesses: 2026 reports of payout delays, rejections and sudden account terminations, which the firm publicly acknowledged on X in March 2026
Traders report high swap/overnight fees relative to peers
Fragmented program lineup (Bootcamp, Hyper Growth, High Stakes, Pro Growth) with different fees/rules per program

name: FundedNext

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No consistency rule on Stellar 2-Step (some other account types, e.g. Stellar Lite, carry consistency requirements)

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 80/20 scaling to 90/10 (Stellar 2-Step); up to 95/5 ceiling on select account types
payoutTerms.payoutCap: None (uncapped; advertises rewards processed in 24h or a $1,000 bonus)

uniqueSellingPoints: One of the most-reviewed prop firms on Trustpilot (77K+ reviews) at a 4.5/5 'Excellent' rating
Challenge fee is refunded with the trader's first reward payout; no recurring/activation fees
Broad platform choice (MT4, MT5, cTrader, Match-Trader) plus a separate futures arm
weaknesses: Multiple trader reports of payout delays of 20-30 days versus the advertised ~14-day cycle, especially around first withdrawal/KYC
Reports of account terminations for 'suspicious trading patterns' flagged shortly before large withdrawal requests
Inconsistent/contradictory information given by support across email, live chat, and social media channels

name: Funded Trading Plus
headquarters: United Kingdom (London; also lists Grimsby, UK and Saint Lucia addresses)

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No single trading day's profit may exceed 50% of total net profit since funding or last payout (discretionary risk review also applies)

payoutTerms.profitSplit: 80/20 (scales to 100/0 as funded profit grows: 90/10 at 20% profit, 100/0 at 30% profit)

uniqueSellingPoints: Profit split scales up to 100% as funded-account profit accumulates, rather than a fixed split
No minimum trading days and no overall time limit on evaluations across most plans
Broad platform choice (MT4, MT5, cTrader, DXtrade, Match Trader) plus instant-funding options
weaknesses: As of August 2026, Trustpilot has suspended/hidden the company's overall score, displaying a banner that the rating is 'unavailable due to a breach of our guidelines' after removing suspected fake reviews

Multiple recent 1-star reviews report funded-account activation delays of 8+ business days and unresponsive support, with several complaints tying the decline to the firm's acquisition by 'Instant Funding'
Reset pricing is a discretionary discount on a new evaluation purchase rather than a fixed, published reset fee

name: City Traders Imperium

drawdownRules.consistencyRule: No consistency rule to pass the 1-Step/2-Step challenge or to qualify for standard payouts; a 20% consistency score applies only for scaling eligibility within the Instant Funding program

uniqueSellingPoints: Challenge fee is refunded with the trader's first profit withdrawal, effectively making a passed evaluation free
VIP tier system unlocks anytime/on-demand payouts as traders progress
Direct Market Access via a CySEC-regulated liquidity partner with tight reported spreads (0-0.2 pips on majors)
weaknesses: Some 1-star Trustpilot reviews describe accounts being closed for alleged 'copy trading' without the firm providing verifiable evidence to the trader

Compliance/KYC process reported as strict, including repeated KYC rejections and a requirement to submit EA/algorithm source code before funded payouts are released, not prominently disclosed pre-purchase
Crypto payouts reportedly carry a 5% fee, and bank transfer payouts can take up to 14 business days
